method: weeks[E] = [tvl_usd at height(E) (reserves from dex-data/state-history × that day’s price), vol_usd (Σ swap offer amounts in [height(E), height(E+1)) from the archive node × the week’s average price), swaps, complete (1 = every page read), unpriced (1 = a token had no price — that side is undercounted), reserve_implied (1 = one token priced from the pool’s own reserves against the other)]. Pool aggregates only.
